model_annotations.Bulgarian: Figure 5 (left) illustrates the proportion of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-2, plotted as a function of layer depth. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," spans from 0 to 20 with numerical tick marks at intervals of 5, using a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, also on a linear scale. Three distinct lines are presented: a dashed gray line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," a solid green line for the "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.04," and a dash-dotted blue line for the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33." The dashed gray line begins at approximately 0.03 at layer 0 and remains nearly flat across all layers, with minor fluctuations. The solid green line starts at approximately 0.03 and shows a slight upward trend, reaching approximately 0.05 at layer 20. The dash-dotted blue line starts at approximately 0.33 and remains relatively constant across all layers, with minor variations, staying close to 0.33 throughout the range. The legend is positioned in the upper right corner of the plot, and the title of the subplot is "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2."

model_annotations.English: Figure 5 (left) illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-2, plotted against the layer number. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 20 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are shown: a dashed gray line representing the sparsity ratio before gating, which starts at approximately 0.9 and decreases to about 0.1 by layer 20; a solid green line representing the sparsity ratio after gating, which starts at approximately 0.4 and remains relatively flat around 0.4 across all layers; and a dash-dotted blue line representing the sparsity ratio after averaging the gating score with pre-gating hidden states, which starts at approximately 0.33 and also remains nearly constant across layers. All three lines are plotted on the same axes, with the dashed gray line showing a steep decline, while the green and blue lines exhibit minimal variation across the layers.
